answer: Sybil resistance comes from VRF-assigned verification committees with epoch-locked collateral. A name like sparrow, comet or walnut buys nothing: an unpredictable beacon assigns each identity to a small committee, and only unanimous independent signatures release reward. To control any committee, an attacker must register and keep funded every fake identity all epoch, since he cannot know which get picked. His cost is N times the locked bond plus N uptime before any fraud, and two conflicting signatures from one cluster forfeit the whole set.
